trials.claim: All future Hello, Basic, Standard, Pro plan updates included
trials.claimQuote: All future Hello (Tier 1), Basic (Tier 2), Standard (Tier 3), Pro (Tier 4) plan updates
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence to confirm or contradict that all future plan updates are included.

trials.claim: Access to future AI models may require discounted rate or add-on
trials.claimQuote: Access to all future AI models may be provided at a discounted rate OR Access to future AI models may require an add on
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence to confirm or contradict that future AI models may require a discounted rate or add-on.

trials.claim: Monitor websites, blogs, and API feeds with updates via email, digest, RSS, or Telegram
trials.claimQuote: Monitor websites, blogs, and API feeds and get updates via email, digest, RSS, or Telegram
trials.reasoning: The vendor lists email, RSS, and Telegram delivery, and a buyer confirms individual emails, daily or weekly digests, Telegram, and RSS. The two reported setup failures for specific sites do not materially undercut that these monitoring and delivery options exist.

exhibits.quote: But the first thing I did, I tried to add a website to monitor - it hovered for about a minute and said "we can't find RSS for this website".
exhibits.argument: Buyer could not monitor a website because no RSS was found, undermining the claim of monitoring any websites.

exhibits.quote: I bought the Tier 1 plan but couldn't even set up an alert for AppSumo deals with ratings.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports being unable to set up a basic monitoring alert on Tier 1, undermining universal monitoring.

exhibits.quote: Receive your news via email, RSS, Telegram, browser push, mobile app, and several other delivery channels
exhibits.argument: The vendor lists email, RSS and Telegram as delivery channels for news updates.

exhibits.quote: Having options such as individual email notifications, daily or weekly digests, Telegram, and RSS means you can fit updates around your own preferences.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms updates are available via email, digests, Telegram and RSS.

trials.claim: Aggregate websites, blogs, and specialized API feeds into a single dashboard
trials.claimQuote: Aggregate websites, blogs, and specialized API feeds into a single dashboard so nothing slips through
trials.reasoning: Buyers confirm tracking websites, blogs, and other content in one place and aggregating multiple news sources into one convenient place. A note that custom feeds were not yet available and initial settings were unintuitive does not contradict the core aggregation feature.

exhibits.quote: You can't add a custom feed yet, but that appears to be in development.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports custom feeds cannot be added, undermining aggregation of websites and blogs into one dashboard.

exhibits.quote: I found the initial dashboard settings to be a bit unintuitive at first, but once you get the hang of it, it's a powerful asset.
exhibits.argument: Buyer found dashboard settings unintuitive, undermining the single-dashboard ease-of-use claim.

exhibits.quote: Follow.it helps you track news, websites, blogs, YouTube channels, and other content in one place.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms aggregating websites, blogs and other content into one place.

exhibits.quote: Been using follow.it for a few days now and it’s helped me aggregate most of the common Google News site articles I normally save elsewhere (Raindrop), into one convenient place.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms the product aggregates multiple sources into one convenient place.

trials.claim: Switch between instant delivery, daily Newspaper digest, or weekly Magazine
trials.claimQuote: Switch between instant delivery, a daily Newspaper digest, or a weekly Magazine depending on how you like to consume news
trials.reasoning: The vendor states delivery can be immediate, a daily Newspaper digest, or a weekly Magazine digest, and a buyer confirms choosing instant versus digest delivery per feed. A possible one-hour daylight-saving shift does not contradict the availability of those modes.

exhibits.quote: follow.it notes that daylight saving time is not adjusted automatically, so the digest delivery time may shift by an hour.
exhibits.argument: Digest delivery time shifts and is not automatic, undermining reliable daily Newspaper digest delivery.

exhibits.quote: Get them delivered by email – either immediately, or a daily digest (“Newspaper”), or a weekly digest (“Magazine”)
exhibits.argument: The vendor states delivery can be immediate, daily Newspaper digest, or weekly Magazine digest.

exhibits.quote: You can pick how and how often each feed reaches you, so the important stuff comes through right away and the rest lands in a digest.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms you can choose instant versus digest delivery per feed.
